Splide 4.1.4 vendor directory.

If official splide.min.js and splide-core.min.css are placed here, the plugin uses them automatically.
Otherwise it uses a local cached copy from WordPress uploads when available, or jsDelivr as a fallback.

The WordPress admin page includes a "Stiahnuť Splide lokálne" action that downloads Splide 4.1.4 to uploads.
